updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Permissions Audit Log Improvements
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview now provides enhanced audit logging for role and scoped-role access decisions, giving administrators clearer visibility into authorization checks when users access the portal. This improvement helps admins troubleshoot access issues and monitor who has what permissions and when.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: View-Only Device Management Role for Endpoint DLP
updates.summary: A new View-Only Device Management role enables granular, least-privilege access to device onboarding settings, allowing auditors and security analysts to view device status without broad administrator roles. This reduces the need to grant Compliance Administrator or Global Administrator permissions for device management tasks.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Scale Increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: The maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive has been increased from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day, enabling organizations to apply sensitivity labels and protection to more data at rest faster. This helps close labeling gaps and prepare data estates for Microsoft 365 Copilot.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Per-Policy Coverage Report
updates.summary: Administrators can now view detailed per-policy coverage reports showing how many files have been labeled or remain unlabeled during auto-labeling enforcement, compared to the last simulation snapshot. This helps track enforcement progress and identify files processed during enforcement that were not included in simulation.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Guided Diagnostics and Troubleshooting
updates.summary: A new guided diagnostics experience helps users understand why DLP policies are or aren't triggering as expected, showing which policies were evaluated, the order of evaluation, and condition details. E5 customers also receive Copilot-powered insights and recommendations to accelerate troubleshooting.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Archive Mailbox Auto-Expansion Beyond 1.5 TB
updates.summary: Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the previous 1.5 TB limit, ensuring continuous retention and preventing mailboxes from becoming inoperative when they reach capacity. This improves scalability for organizations with high data retention requirements.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP FTP and SFTP Monitoring
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now supports monitoring of sensitive data transferred over FTP and SFTP protocols, allowing organizations to apply restrictive actions based on their policies. Admins can configure FTP and SFTP transfer activities in Endpoint DLP policies for comprehensive data protection.

updates.title: CVE-2026-105590: Active Directory Certificate Services Security Feature Bypass
updates.summary: Improper certificate validation in Windows Active Directory Certificate Services allows an authorized attacker to bypass security features over a network. Organizations should apply the security update promptly to prevent certificate-based attacks.

updates.title: CVE-2026-109460: Microsoft Entra Private Network Connector Information Disclosure
updates.summary: Exposure of sensitive information in Microsoft Entra Private Network Connector allows authorized attackers to disclose information locally. Organizations using Entra Private Network Connector should apply the available security update.

updates.title: CVE-2026-121680: Windows NTLM Spoofing Vulnerability
updates.summary: A spoofing vulnerability in Windows NTLM affects Microsoft Office software and could allow attackers to impersonate legitimate users or systems. Organizations running supported Office versions should update to the indicated patch to mitigate this identity-based threat.

updates.title: CVE-2026-109467: Azure DevOps Server Remote Code Execution
updates.summary: Improper authentication in Azure DevOps Server allows authorized attackers to execute arbitrary code over a network. Admins should prioritize patching Azure DevOps servers to prevent code execution and potential lateral movement.

updates.title: CVE-2026-109455: SharePoint Incorrect Authorization Information Disclosure
updates.summary: Incorrect authorization in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows authorized attackers to disclose sensitive information over a network. Organizations should apply available security updates to prevent unauthorized data exposure.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62903: SQL Client Authentication Bypass and Information Disclosure
updates.summary: An authentication bypass vulnerability in Microsoft.Data.SqlClient allows unauthorized attackers to disclose information over a network through capture-replay attacks. Teams managing SQL Server connections should update the affected library to secure their database authentication.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM Copilot Readiness and Data Explorer
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management introduces new readiness assessment and data explorer capabilities to help security teams evaluate data security posture and Copilot readiness. These tools provide visibility into sensitive data exposure, oversharing, and protection coverage.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Scalability and Policy Management Enhancements
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview is expanding auto-labeling capabilities with larger SharePoint scope support, improved policy management flexibility, and richer visibility into auto-labeling activity. These enhancements enable organizations to manage labeling policies at enterprise scale more effectively.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Policy Sync & Device Health AI-Powered Investigation
updates.summary: AI-powered visibility into Endpoint DLP policy deployment across devices helps administrators track sync progress, identify impacted devices, explain root causes of failures, and receive recommended remediation actions. This accelerates troubleshooting and ensures consistent policy enforcement.
